definitions.explanation: A ceramic bowl with ridged interior used for grinding sesame seeds, miso, and other ingredients. Used with a wooden pestle called surikogi.

examples.english: Grind sesame seeds in a mortar.

examples.japanese: {擂|す}り{鉢|ばち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{擂|す}り{粉木|こぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{必需品|ひつじゅひん}→必需品：15541_hitsujuhin⟧だ。
examples.english: A mortar and pestle are essential items in a Japanese kitchen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擂|す}り{鉢|ばち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{滑|なめ}らか→滑らか：06068_nameraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Make the miso smooth using a mortar.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{擂|す}る (to grind) + {鉢|ばち} (bowl)

RELATED TOOL:
{擂|す}り{粉木|こぎ} (surikogi) - the wooden pestle used with the mortar

FEATURES:
The inside has ridged grooves ({櫛目|くしめ}) that help grind ingredients. Traditional ones are made of ceramic (⟦{陶器|とうき}→陶器：14531_touki⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ごま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擂|す}る - grinding sesame seeds
- ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擂|す}る - grinding miso paste
- ⟦{山芋|やまいも}→山芋：22494_yamaimo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擂|す}る - grinding mountain yam
- ⟦{白和|しらあ}え→白和え：15361_shiraae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ - making shira-ae (tofu salad)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{擂|す}り{鉢|ばち}⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ - bowl-shaped, concave (describing terrain or shapes)
